title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era

claims.claim: Sequoia announced a broad overhaul in a memo posted to X, which includes closing its London office and shutting down its scout program.

evidence.quote: Sequoia this week announced a broad overhaul in a memo posted to X, a move that includes closing its London office and shutting down its scout program.

claims.claim: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model 17 years ago.

evidence.quote: That’s partly because 17 years ago, Sequoia pioneered the scouts model, in which select founders and operators write checks on the firm’s behalf.

claims.claim: VC Sheel Mohnot wrote on X this week that the scout program never made sense to him and he suspects other firms will shutter theirs too.

evidence.quote: “They pioneered the scout program but [to be honest] it never made sense to me!” VC Sheel Mohnot wrote on X this week.
“I suspect other firms will shutter theirs too.” he added.

claims.claim: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) rolled out a global scout network aimed at spotting opportunities in the U.S. and smaller European hubs.

evidence.quote: Rival firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), for instance, rolled out a global scout network aimed at spotting opportunities in the U.S. and also in smaller European hubs.

claims.claim: a16z partner Gabriel Vasquez told TechCrunch earlier this year that the firm had revamped its program to double down on the best people.

evidence.quote: But a16z partner Gabriel Vasquez told TechCrunch earlier this year that the firm had revamped its program to double down “on the best people.”

claims.claim: Station F boss Roxanne Varza wrote on LinkedIn that she was sad to hear that Sequoia's scout program was getting cut off.

evidence.quote: Among them is Station F boss Roxanne Varza, who wrote on LinkedIn that she was “sad” to hear that the program was getting cut off

claims.claim: Roxanne Varza served as a Sequoia scout from 2020 to 2025.

evidence.quote: Varza, a former Sequoia scout from 2020 to 2025, told TechCrunch that she had no information beyond what has been shared publicly
